get.summary: ListAuditEntries lists entries, newest first. Needs audit:read.

post.summary:
Login checks an admin's password. An admin without a second factor gets a session; one
with a second factor gets a challenge that VerifyLogin completes.
VerifyLogin completes a login challenge with a TOTP or SMS code.
Logout ends the calling admin's session. 204.

get.summary: GetMe returns the calling admin with their role and permissions.

patch.summary: ChangePassword changes the calling admin's password and ends their other sessions. 204.
SetSmsCodes turns SMS codes as a second factor on or off. 204.

post.summary: StartTotp begins adding an authenticator app: scan the QR code, then ConfirmTotp.
ConfirmTotp turns the authenticator app on with a first code. 204.
DisableTotp turns the authenticator app off with a current code. 204.

ForgotPassword texts a 6-digit code to the admin's phone number. It answers the same for
unknown, disabled or phone-less accounts. 202, no body.
ResetPassword sets a new password with the texted code and ends every session. 204.

get.summary: ListPermissions lists the permission catalogue. Needs role:read.
ListPlayers lists the brand's players, filtered. Needs player:read.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: PENDING_VERIFICATION, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, SELF_EXCLUDED or CLOSED.

get.summary: GetPlayer reads one player. Needs player:read.
ListPlayerExclusions lists a player's exclusions, newest first. Needs player:read.

post.summary:
ExcludePlayer excludes a player on their behalf, under the self-exclusion rules. Needs
player:exclude. 201.

patch.summary: ChangePlayerStatus suspends, reactivates or closes a player. Needs player:status.

get.summary: ListRoles lists the system roles and the operator's custom roles. Needs role:read.

post.summary: CreateRole creates a custom role. Needs role:write. 201.

get.summary: GetRole reads a role. Needs role:read.

delete.summary: DeleteRole deletes a custom role no user holds. Needs role:write. 204.

put.summary: UpdateRole replaces a custom role's name, description and permissions. Needs role:write.

get.summary: ListAttackModes lists the endpoints in attack mode. Needs security:read.

put.summary:
StartAttackMode puts an endpoint in attack mode for 1 minute to 24 hours. Needs
security:write.

delete.summary: StopAttackMode ends attack mode on an endpoint. Needs security:write. 204.

get.summary: ListUsers lists back-office users. Needs admin_user:read.

post.summary: CreateUser creates a back-office user. Needs admin_user:write. 201.

get.summary: GetUser reads a back-office user. Needs admin_user:read.

patch.summary: UpdateUser changes the fields sent. Needs admin_user:write.

put.summary:
ResetUserPassword sets another user's password and ends their sessions. Needs
admin_user:write. 204.

patch.summary:
SetUserEnabled enables or disables a user; disabling ends their sessions. Needs
admin_user:write.

get.summary: GetBalance returns the player's balance.

post.summary:
CreateChallenge returns a proof-of-work puzzle, as identity.v1.AuthService.CreateChallenge
does for the apps: the back office needs one when admin login answers 428 (suspicious
traffic, or attack mode on admin_login). It shares identity.v1's messages on purpose.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The JSON body, which may name the endpoint instead.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description:
The endpoint the puzzle is for, from the query string (?endpoint=login): signup, login,
verify, resend, forgot, reset, admin_login, admin_forgot or admin_reset. When empty, the
body's endpoint is used, and then signup.

get.summary:
GetPublicConfig returns the settings of the brand resolved for the request (from the
session, or the site's domain) that a player app needs before signup.

GetLimits returns the daily spend limit, any raise still waiting, today's spend, what's
left and when the day resets.

put.summary:
SetLimits sets the daily spend limit (0 removes it). Lowering applies at once; raising or
removing applies after the brand's cooling-off hours.

post.summary:
Login checks a player's password and starts a session. The player is identified by
exactly one of msisdn, email or username.
Logout ends the calling player's session. Needs a player session. 204.

patch.summary:
ForgotPassword texts a password-reset code. It answers the same whether or not the
number has an account. 202.
ResetPassword sets a new password with the texted code and ends every session.

get.summary: ListBrands lists brands, optionally of one operator.

post.summary: OnboardBrand creates a brand (PENDING) with its settings. 201.

get.summary: GetBrand reads one brand.
ListBrandDomains lists a brand's domains.

post.summary: AddBrandDomain registers a domain the brand's sites or back office run on. 201.

get.summary: GetBrandSettings reads a brand's settings.

put.summary:
UpdateBrandSettings replaces a brand's settings. The body is the whole settings object
with the version it was read at; a stale version is a conflict.

get.summary: ListOperators lists every operator.

post.summary: CreateOperator creates an operator, the company that owns brands. 201.

get.summary: GetOperator reads one operator.
GetProfile returns the calling player. Needs a player session.

post.summary:
SelfExclude creates the calling player's exclusion, or extends the open one to a later
end date. A start date of today applies at once and ends every session; a later one is
SCHEDULED. Needs a player session. 201.

patch.summary:
ChangePassword changes the calling player's password and ends their other sessions.
Needs a player session. 204.

post.summary:
Signup creates a player of the brand. With OTP verification a code is sent by SMS and
verification_required is true; with DIRECT verification a session is returned. 201.

get.summary: ListTransactions returns the history, newest first; pass next as after for the next page.

post.summary: VerifyPhone confirms the signup code, activates the player and starts a session.

ResendCode sends a new signup code to an unverified player. It answers the same whether
or not the number has an account. 202.

get.summary:
GetWithdrawalSettings returns the brand's withdrawal limits, charges and tax, for the
withdraw form.

google.protobuf.NullValue.description:
Represents a JSON `null`.

`NullValue` is a sentinel, using an enum with only one value to represent
the null value for the `Value` type union.

A field of type `NullValue` with any value other than `0` is considered
invalid. Most ProtoJSON serializers will emit a Value with a `null_value` set
as a JSON `null` regardless of the integer value, and so will round trip to
a `0` value.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

brand_ids.description: The brands worked on when all_brands is false.

totp_enabled.description: An authenticator app as a second factor.

brand_ids.description:
A JSON array of brand ids. Sent (even empty) to change the user's brands; absent keeps
them. A ListValue, because a repeated field can't tell empty from absent.

identity.v1.Attribution.description:
Attribution records where a signup came from. The client's IP and user agent are taken
from the request, not from here.

difficulty.description: Leading zero hex digits a solution needs.

identity.v1.IssuedSession.description: IssuedSession is a player session: send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

channel.description: WEB, ANDROID, IOS, USSD, RETAIL or API.

status.description: PENDING_VERIFICATION, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, SELF_EXCLUDED or CLOSED.

identity.v1.PlayerProfile.description: PlayerProfile is a player as the player sees themselves.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, whole days in the brand's timezone.

msisdn.description: Any local or international form; normalised with the brand's country.

channel.description: WEB, ANDROID, IOS, USSD, RETAIL or API.

session.description: Set when the brand verifies directly (no code).

next.description: Set when there may be more.
